role: Exploratory follow-up on previously inspected round14 data; not a new blind or prospective test
numeric_training: Reuse sealed round14 train+calibration weights; compare selection only, without refitting
selection_boundary: All fixed rules use decision segment ending 2024-05-14. Online rules use only complete matured targets with past origin + H <= current origin.
attribution_base: Use the original round14 selected numeric family at each horizon, holding numeric predictions and training residual origins constant across controls
constant_correction: Mean round14 chronological OOF training residual, applied only on the same text-available origins
state_selection: Fit features and correction on the same OOF residual origins. Choose alpha on calibration using round14 train-only calibration predictions; apply frozen correction to final train+cal base.
centered_text: Original text correction minus mean OOF residual, masked on identical origins; a decomposition diagnostic, not an independently trained model
gate_selection: Choose eligible weight on decision MSE, requiring positive benefit in both contiguous halves for nonzero weights
interpretation: Exploratory pointwise intervals without multiple-comparison correction; reused targets limit claims. Strict source eligibility remains zero. No new architecture, no guaranteed superiority.
